channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Optimum opens 19th annual Hispanic Heritage Essay Contest for students
item.description: Optimum's 19th annual Hispanic Heritage Essay Contest invites middle and high schoolers to explore Hispanic culture for a shot at a $3,000 scholarship.

item.title: Tigres officially signs striker Guillermo 'Memote' Martínez from Pumas
item.description: Tigres pays $1.3 million to land the 31-year-old Mexican international as a last-minute addition to fill a gaping hole up front.

item.title: Supreme Court again blocks Missouri's new GOP congressional map
item.description: Missouri's congressional map fight reveals a deeper, unresolved tension between federal and state authority over federal elections.

item.title: New York Latino Film Festival opens its 26th edition in September
item.description: The New York Latino Film Festival returns September 15–20, 2026, bringing over 125 films from 20 countries to celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month.

item.title: Mexican striker Julián Quiñones nominated for Ballon d'Or 2026
item.description: Quiñones lands a Ballon d'Or nomination for the first time in 19 years for a Mexican player, backed by 41 goals and a strong World Cup.

item.title: MoneyGram launches stablecoin Visa card first in Colombia
item.description: MoneyGram's stablecoin Visa card goes live in Colombia first, letting users hold dollar balances and spend where Visa is accepted.

item.title: Trump pledges $5,000 dividend to adults if Republicans win midterms
item.description: Trump told supporters at a Dallas convention that every adult citizen would receive $5,000 if Republicans hold Congress in November.

item.title: Nubank enters US market with savings account, credit card, and remittances
item.description: Nu Holdings launches a no-fee credit card, a 3.50% APY savings account, and fee-free remittances to three countries on September 10, 2026.

item.title: Petrobras extends natural gas supply deal with Braskem to 2029
item.description: Braskem's gas supply deal with Petrobras grows to BRL 1.85 billion and runs three years longer than originally planned.

item.title: 9/11's 25th anniversary splits parties on war, memory, and security powers
item.description: The 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks is dividing both parties on questions of memory, national security powers, and the Iran war.

item.title: Republicans hold first-ever midterm convention in Dallas
item.description: The Republican National Committee convened in Dallas for what it called the first midterm convention in modern American political history.

item.title: Turning Point USA marks one year since Charlie Kirk's assassination
item.description: Turning Point USA marked one year since Charlie Kirk's fatal shooting with a memorial at Utah Valley University as his trial moves forward.

item.title: Trump promises $500 ACA rebate checks to 1 million enrollees
item.description: President Trump pledged $500 checks to roughly 1 million ACA enrollees in 30 states, citing what he called a Biden-era surplus of exchange user fees.

item.title: De Paul taunts Lewandowski with World Cup record in MLS draw
item.description: De Paul invoked his two Copa Américas and a World Cup to silence Lewandowski after a late scuffle at Soldier Field.

item.title: Petrobras corrects gasoline price after Brazil cuts fuel taxes
item.description: A midnight correction untangled two identical R$0.63 figures that briefly made it look like a tax cut and a price hike cancelled each other out.

item.title: 9/11 25th anniversary marked by new museum exhibition and illness toll
item.description: As the 25th anniversary arrives, the death toll keeps climbing and a trove of newly released documents raises enduring questions about what officials knew.

item.title: GOP courts Hispanic voters at Dallas convention as Texas polls tighten
item.description: Republicans gathered in Dallas to make their case to Hispanic voters as new polling shows Democratic candidates competitive across Texas.

item.title: Chile's central bank slashes 2026 growth forecast to near zero
item.description: The central bank's September report puts 2026 GDP growth as low as 0.25%, with investment swinging to a contraction and unemployment at a post-pandemic high.

item.title: Connecticut governor's race sees ads on ICE enforcement and abortion
item.description: The Connecticut governor's race draws immigration and abortion into focus as campaigns release competing ads ahead of the November 2026 election.

item.title: Houthis enter Mokha as Perim Island becomes Bab al-Mandab prize
item.description: Houthi rebels entered Mokha on September 10 while simultaneously pressing to seize Perim Island, escalating their campaign to dominate the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

item.title: ICSID rules Mexico violated NAFTA in Vulcan Materials dispute
item.description: ICSID orders Mexico to pay $15.9 million to Vulcan Materials — less than 1% of the $1.9 billion the U.S. company sought.

item.title: Library of Congress marks Hispanic Heritage Month with new resources and events
item.description: The Library of Congress is rolling out new guides, transcription projects, and virtual events to celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month through October 15.

item.title: Trump bans Canadian alcohol and motorcycles as trade war escalates
item.description: A 1930 tariff law, a $20 billion tit-for-tat, and two governments testing how much economic pain their publics can absorb.

item.title: IAEA blind to Iran nuclear sites as Trump warns over Pickaxe Mountain
item.description: Trump warned Iran at a Dallas convention not to 'get cute' over Pickaxe Mountain as international inspectors remain locked out of Iranian nuclear sites.

item.title: Trump predicts Iran war will end immediately after midterm elections
item.description: President Trump told reporters Tuesday that the seven-month war with Iran will end immediately after the November 3 midterm elections.

item.title: Southern California marks Fiestas Patrias with festivals and parades
item.description: From El Grito ceremonies to parades and live music, Southern California is celebrating Fiestas Patrias with events across the region this September.

item.title: Twenty states and DC sue Trump over Endangered Species Act rules
item.description: Democratic attorneys general from 20 states and Washington, DC, filed two federal lawsuits September 9 challenging Trump administration changes to endangered species protections.

item.title: Jim Jordan to give up Judiciary and Oversight committee gavels
item.description: Rep. Jim Jordan said Wednesday he will not seek waivers to retain his Judiciary Committee chairmanship or his Oversight Committee ranking position.

item.title: Zelenskyy's Moldova-to-Norway flight delayed by Russian drone incursion
item.description: Moldova closed its airspace after a Russian drone crashed in the Riscani district, delaying Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's flight to Oslo.

item.title: Messi assists Casemiro equalizer as Inter Miami draws Chicago Fire 1-1
item.description: A Messi corner and Casemiro header cancelled Robert Lewandowski's early strike as 63,094 fans set a Fire attendance record at Soldier Field.

item.title: Fetterman appears by video at GOP convention, touts McCormick and Trump
item.description: Fetterman's convention cameo is unusual, but the structural forces pulling him toward the political center have deep roots worth examining.

item.title: Trump promises $5,000 dividend if Republicans hold Congress
item.description: President Trump pledged a $5,000 'Trump dividend' to every adult American if Republicans hold both chambers of Congress in November.

item.title: Márquez set for first Mexico squad as Quiñones call-up in doubt
item.description: Márquez names his first Mexico squad this week with four U.S. friendlies lined up, but Julián Quiñones's spot remains unresolved.

item.title: Republicans open first-ever midterm convention in Dallas
item.description: The Republican National Committee opened its first-ever midterm convention Wednesday in Dallas, featuring 109 speakers and a promise of $5,000 payments to Americans.

item.title: Inter Miami's Messi draws record crowd at Soldier Field
item.description: 63,094 fans packed Soldier Field on September 9 as Chicago and Miami split points in a pivotal Eastern Conference clash.

item.title: Mexico's Plan México is on track but needs faster execution, official says
item.description: A top economic official says Plan México is moving forward but must pick up speed, as private-equity inflows hit $6 billion in six months.

item.title: Chile holds interest rate at 4.5% amid weak growth and rising inflation
item.description: Chile's central bank held rates steady for the sixth straight meeting as the economy contracts and inflation climbs past its 3% target.

item.title: Map opponents ask Supreme Court to block federal judge's order on Missouri districts
item.description: People Not Politicians asked the U.S. Supreme Court on September 9 to halt a federal judge's order directing Missouri to use the 2025 congressional map.

item.title: Trump says Putin wants Ukraine deal as Kyiv hits Arctic gas plant
item.description: President Trump said Wednesday that Vladimir Putin is willing to end the war in Ukraine, as Kyiv launched its longest-range drone strike of the conflict.

item.title: Rubio visits Ecuador, seeks $45M security package, receives decoration
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio visited Quito on September 9, seeking $45 million in new congressional security funding and receiving Ecuador's highest civilian honor.
